name: Signs of Pluto Destruction
source:
Despite living in a horrible world where chaos surrounds you, you recently allowed yourself to try starting a new life, attempting to forget your sadness and be happy with your new boyfriend.

A normal boyfriend. There’s nothing wrong with your boyfriend.

Right?

[From [url=https://zmakiya.itch.io/signsofplutodestruction]Itch.io[/url]]

尽管生活在一个充满混乱的可怕世界中，你最近还是允许自己尝试开始新的生活，试图忘记悲伤并与新男友一起快乐。

一个正常的男朋友。你男朋友没有什么问题。
